simple.meaning: עֲבַד (ʻăbad) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a servant.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Ezra 4:11. The surrounding context includes kingship, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֲבַד (H5649) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: עֲבַד (ʻăbad) / H5649 is traced through Ezra 4:11, Ezra 5:11, Daniel 2:4, Daniel 2:7 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: This is the copy of the letter that they sent:

Thus they returned us answer, saying, “We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and are building the house that was built these many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and finished.
Then the Chaldeans spoke to the king in the Syrian language, “O king, live forever! Tell your servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.”
Then the Chaldeans spoke to the king in the Syrian language, “O king, live forever! Tell your servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.”
They answered the second time and said, “Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.”
Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace. He spoke and said, “Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, you servants of the Most High God, come out, and come here!”

Nebuchadnezzar spoke and said, “Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, who has sent his angel, and delivered his servants who trusted in him, and have changed the king’s word, and have yielded their bodies, that they might not serve nor worship any god, except their own God.
Then Daniel said to the king, “O king, live forever!

definitions.full: H5649. abad [ עֲבַד D p.105 , or עֲבֵד K § 54, 3. γ )] noun masculine slave, servant (Biblical Hebrew עֶ֫בֶד ); — construct עֲבֵד Dan 6:21 servant of God; plural suffix of king, עבדיך Kt (K § 53 Anm. b )), עַבְדָּךְ Qr Ezra 4:11 , עַבְדָךְ Qr Dan 2:4 ; suffix of God, עַבְד֫וֺתִי , 3:26 , 28 ; Ezra 5:11 , of king Dan 2:7 .
